CognitiveResponsibilityProposal.description:
Complete human intention and expected result type understood by GI.

Live GI supplies natural-language meaning and current-turn provenance only.
Planner selects Capabilities, realizes parameters and decomposes Activities.
GA alone selects canonical Goal relationships; SC owns communication wording.
Retained typed fields below describe existing persisted sources, not permission
for the live GI decoder to author parameter or continuity contracts.

outcome.description: Complete natural-language user request with every material detail, in the source language. Never a category name, code or underscore-separated identifier.
outcome.title: Outcome

output_mode.description: Expected human result type only; the complete request belongs in outcome.
output_mode.title: Output Mode

ResponsibilitySourceEvidence.description:
Primary-result citation into the authoritative admitted turn.

Goal Interpretation owns the semantic choice of the cited span. Trusted code
resolves the two closed token references back to the immutable turn and checks
only provenance, order, and non-overlap; it never retypes or resegments WHAT.
ResponsibilitySourceEvidence.title: ResponsibilitySourceEvidence

description:
Canonical model-facing Goal Interpretation contract: WHAT only.

Fast/Deep depth may change how much cognition is used, but never this authority.
No route/intent label, response Activity, Work, Capability, provider, execution
contract, or canonical lifecycle identity belongs here.
